targets.review_note: For everypossiblegcd g, considerpresentmultiples dividedbyg and findmaximumproduct ofcoprime pair. Processnormalizedvalues descending. Inclusion-exclusion over distinctprimefactors counts previouscoprimevalues using lists ofpositions divisible by eachsquarefree divisor; binarysearch earliestprefix withpositivecount finds the largest coprimepartner. CandidateLCM=g*x*y. Descending productupperbounds skip branches only when improvement impossible; maximuminput initializes validlowerbound since any distinctpairLCM>=eachmember. Duplicateequalvalues neednoextra handling because theirLCM cannot exceedthatbound. Sieve supplies factorization. Validate literal pairwisegcd oracle, samples, full100kvalues and adversarial pairwise-noncoprime family divisibleby6,10or15.
